facts.value: The matching of students and master thesis supervisors is conducted through a centralized process for all chairs within the finance department.
facts.programme_association: Master Thesis - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: Students must have completed the specialisation in Finance, achieved 36 CP in Finance courses, successfully completed the two core courses 'Capital Markets and Asset Pricing' and 'Corporate Finance and Valuation', and a Finance seminar.
facts.programme_association: Master Thesis - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: Remaining capacity for supervision will be allocated based on how strongly a student focused on finance-related academic matters during their studies and the success in these areas.
facts.programme_association: Master Thesis - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: If student demand for master thesis supervision significantly exceeds the available capacity, the department will have to limit the amount of students to be supervised.
facts.programme_association: Master Thesis - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: Summer Term results by March 1st and Winter Term results by October 15th.

facts.value: Registration must be done using the online tool provided on the programme page.
facts.programme_association: Master Thesis - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: Applicants must have personal data, student-ID, and transcripts from the Examination Office (as pdf) accessible via QIS/LSF, and must use their student email address.

facts.value: After successful registration, a thank you message will appear on the screen and a confirmation email will be sent.

facts.value: Students can withdraw from their master thesis registration by sending an email to masterallocation[at]finance.uni-frankfurt[dot]de after the assignment of supervisors.

facts.value: The master thesis registration tool does not replace the official registration with the examination office. The form 'Assignment and Advisory of Master Thesis' must be signed by the supervising professor.

facts.value: Most chairs will discuss and suggest potential thesis topics only after students have been assigned to them.
